inclusions.text: Lunch at a local restaurant (traditional Egyptian food)
inclusions.source: Lunch follows — a pause at a local restaurant where traditional Egyptian food is provided.

inclusions.text: Entry to the Valley of the Kings
inclusions.source: Entry to the valley is included; your guide will indicate which tombs are open and most rewarding to visit on the day, as access rotates for conservation reasons.

This tour suits travellers based in Cairo who have limited time and want a serious encounter with Upper Egypt's monuments — not a cultural overview, but a direct experience of the sites themselves, with a licensed guide to give them context.

exclusions.text: Tutankhamun's tomb (KV62) carries a separate ticket
exclusions.source: Tutankhamun's tomb (KV62) carries a separate ticket inside the Valley of the Kings; the contents themselves are now at the Grand Egyptian Museum.
